Proposition
[A rank-1 distribution is a rank-1 subbundle]

↗ def:rank-one-distribution ↗ lem:local-frame-criterion-for-subbundles ↗ prop:existence-riemannian-metric

Every rank-1 tangent distribution is a smooth rank-1 subbundle of $TM$.

Proof

↗ def:rank-one-distribution ↗ lem:local-frame-criterion-for-subbundles \sketch The local field in Definition 16 is a one-element linearly independent family spanning $D$. Apply the local-frame criterion with $k=1$.

□
